name: Combined optimization strategies
definition: Four specific combinations of X-face and X-cube criteria that optimize different aspects of the resulting mesh. The notation min(W) stands for the subset σ of all meshes M such that W(m) has its minimum value for all m in σ. High and Low are used where maximum/minimum cannot be guaranteed.
summary: Combined optimization strategies resolve X-face and X-cube ambiguities by prioritizing specific mesh metrics like minimizing triangles or maximizing shells to optimize isosurface topology.
